source.quote: Audiophonics' own product page, read 2026-11-27, for a Raspberry Pi DAC board. Converter « ES9023 »; rates « 24bit 192 kHz »; input I2S on the Raspberry Pi GPIO (and an XHP header); output RCA; « Horloge TCXO 50MHZ 0.5ppm ». Driver: « Hifiberry DAC ».

_maker_terms: See brands/audiophonics.json: the maker's terms forbid reproduction; recorded on the project owner's decision of 2026-11-27, pending written permission.
_no_DSD: No DSD on the page; dsd_max is left out (see vocabulary/dsd-max-has-no-word-for-none.json).
